npm.availabilityNote: This is the opt-in beta stream on npm, under the beta dist-tag. There is no stable release yet. Install it with npm install -g bowerloom@beta.
npm.identityEvidence: Authenticated npm whoami observation on 2026-10-06. Package ownership and publication authorization remain separate.

requirements.backend: Docker Desktop and a separate approved Supabase/PostgreSQL setup for backend operations

tested.scope: Isolated package installation, setup, revision, upgrade and removal with cached dependencies

systems.note: Clean public installation and additional systems remain under review.

capabilities.setup: Prepare and review a personal-agent profile, team specification and working agreement in a new or existing project. Exact approval installs the planned files.
capabilities.revision: Review an installed setup change before applying its exact revision.
capabilities.execution: Setup does not start workers, grant runtime access, or authorize connected actions.
capabilities.harnesses: Codex and Claude Code execution require separate qualification. File portability does not establish runtime support.
capabilities.connections: MCP connections and local backends require separate reviewed bindings and permissions.
capabilities.company: Shared company access, offboarding and deletion remain release requirements.
limits: The initial beta needs founder acceptance and publication approval.
Unattended support requires an independently accepted installed security configuration.
